name: Thoroughbred sesamoid µCT radiomics benchmark
description: Benchmarks the performance and reproducibility of radiomics feature computation from µCT images of Thoroughbred proximal sesamoid bones.
evaluation_method: reproducibility and agreement metrics (intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC), concordance correlation coefficient, coefficient of variation) and related statistical comparisons
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark of interest to researchers in radiomics and veterinary imaging; limited broader adoption.
notes: Small, specialized dataset (Thoroughbred proximal sesamoid µCTs); results sensitive to preprocessing, segmentation, and feature extraction settings. Non-LLM benchmark with limited generalizability to other species or imaging modalities.
